scope: Core protected provider-intent failover suppression composed with Agent DynamicReservationLeaseSession
proven_gap: Agent materialization changes the first Responses call from AccountLease.run to DynamicReservationLeaseSession.run_selected. V41 on AccountLease alone is therefore insufficient unless allow_failover is explicitly forwarded through the dynamic-session wrapper.

candidate_rule.default: allow_failover=true keeps the legacy call shape and existing Agent failover behavior
candidate_rule.protected: allow_failover=false is forwarded to the real AccountLease.run for run_selected and later run calls
candidate_rule.reservation_reselection: late foreground reservation before provider entry remains a local routing event and may safely reselect while preserving allow_failover=false for the eventual provider step

local_model_cases: legacy fake lease remains compatible when allow_failover is left at default true
protected run_selected forwards false; ambiguous transport performs one provider attempt and zero account switches
default Agent path still permits ordinary failover
protected later planner step forwards false and performs zero account switches
late reservation before provider entry reselects from account a to b and the eventual provider step still receives allow_failover=false
